title: Hierarchical Gaussian Processes for Survey Weighting: Local Equivalent Weights in Structured Populations
abstract: arXiv:2610.20321v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Regression-based survey weighting connects model-based population estimation with design-based inference through equivalent weights. For nonlinear models, equivalent weights can be defined locally through the sensitivity of a poststratified population estimator. However, conventional regression models may inadequately capture nonlinear relationships and complex interactions across sparse poststratification cells. We develop a survey-weighting framework based on hierarchical Gaussian process (HGP) regression, combining structured group-level effects with kernel-based smoothing to share information across related cells. We derive Gaussian posterior prediction formulas that exploit the structured covariance representation to reduce computational costs. translated_title: 用于调查加权的层次高斯过程：结构化总体中的局部等价权重
translated_abstract: 基于回归的调查加权通过等价权重将基于模型的总体估计与基于设计的推断联系起来。对于非线性模型，等价权重可以通过后分层总体估计量的敏感性进行局部定义。然而，传统回归模型可能无法充分捕捉稀疏后分层单元格中的非线性关系和复杂交互作用。我们开发了一个基于层次高斯过程（HGP）回归的调查加权框架，将结构化的组级效应与基于核的平滑相结合，以在相关单元格之间共享信息。我们推导了利用结构化协方差表示来降低计算成本的高斯后验预测公式。我们还在给定的正则性条件下建立了后验预测均值的均匀收敛结果，并通过匹配一阶敏感性来构建局部等价权重。
tldr: 本文提出基于层次高斯过程回归的调查加权新框架，通过结构化组级效应与核平滑在稀疏后分层单元格间共享信息，在降低计算成本的同时为非线性模型构建了局部等价权重并给出了理论收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a hierarchical Gaussian process regression framework for survey weighting that shares information across sparse poststratification cells via structured group-level effects and kernel smoothing, derives computationally efficient posterior prediction formulas, and constructs local equivalent weights with uniform convergence guarantees for nonlinear models.
